policy.description: Delete wazuh-alerts-* thirty days after creation. Wazuh ships no retention policy at all, so without this the answer is 'forever' and the shard budget is spent inside a month. Thirty days is what a 2 GiB heap buys at one primary shard per daily index (ADR-0030); it is a bound and not a measurement, re-derived from _plugins/_ism/explain/wazuh-alerts-* once the lab has run a fortnight.
